# Harrison

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** married  <sub>[v2 c25 P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c2 P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** James A.  <sub>[v2 c25 P10](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0010)</sub>; J. A. Harrison  <sub>[v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a short, fat, bald man with a round face, prominent blue eyes, and a small fringe of hair around his ears. After his wife returns, he becomes much better groomed, keeping his face neatly shaved, his clothes patched, and his hair trimmed.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c1 P21](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0021), [v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046)_

## Personality

Blunt and outspoken, he prides himself on telling the unvarnished truth regardless of others' feelings, which earns him a reputation as an odd crank. Beneath his crusty, irritable exterior lies a kindly and sociable nature that enjoys good company, humor, and a bit of fun. He is stubborn and set in his ways, yet capable of showing genuine friendliness, sympathy, and generosity once his goodwill is earned.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c3 P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 c3 P47](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0047), [v2 c3 P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009), [v2 c9 P41](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0041)_

## History

After the death of his sister in Scottsford, New Brunswick, Mr. Harrison married Emily Scott. Their marriage suffered due to her obsession with neatness and her dislike of his profanely inclined parrot, Ginger; after a clash over the bird, Emily left him. Mr. Harrison then moved to Avonlea and bought Robert Bell's farm next to Green Gables, living as a bachelor with his parrot. He clashed initially with Anne Shirley when her cow broke into his oatfield, but they reconciled after Anne accidentally sold his cow under the impression that it was her own. Anne confessed her mistake and offered her own cow in replacement, winning his friendship. Later, his wife Emily discovered a false newspaper notice hinting at his remarriage and arrived at Avonlea to reunite with him. After Ginger's death in a severe thunderstorm, the couple settled into a tidy, harmonious life together, remaining good neighbors to the Green Gables household.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 c3 P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P41](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0041), [v2 c24 P2](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0002), [v2 c24 P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 c24 P44](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0044), [v2 c25 P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012), [v2 c25 P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c25 P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 c25 P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065)_
